title: Deta Technologies
hook: Client work that turned me into a full-stack developer.
text: During my time at Deta Technologies, I grew into a full-stack developer by working on meaningful projects and gaining hands-on experience in real-world software development. I learned how industry standards, development practices and professional workflows operate — and how to apply those principles to my own day-to-day work.
highlights: Learned industry standards and professional workflows.
Applied those practices to my own projects afterwards.

caseStudy.problem: I could build things, but I had not yet worked inside the standards and workflows of a professional software team.
caseStudy.approach: I joined Deta Technologies and worked on client projects end to end, learning the practices that sit around the code: review, process and delivery.
caseStudy.outcome: The experience changed how I build: the same standards now apply to my personal and client work.
caseStudy.learned: The gap between a working prototype and professional software is mostly discipline. Process is not bureaucracy when it protects the people using the result.
